readings.Aries: You want to move faster than the situation allows. The friction is informative. Read it. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Taurus: Stubbornness and consistency are the same trait in different lighting. Today, which one is it? Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Gemini: The idea you dismissed too quickly deserves another look. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Cancer: The mood has been difficult and you've been managing it alone. That arrangement can change. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Leo: The performance you're giving is excellent. There is something you're not saying behind it. The first instinct was right.
readings.Virgo: The system you've built is working. You are allowed to stop improving it for one day. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Libra: The mirror you hold up to others reflects you too. What do you see? The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Scorpio: You process everything through transformation. Even rest, in you, becomes power. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Sagittarius: Something you believed absolutely is no longer something you believe absolutely. That's growth. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Capricorn: There is a difference between discipline and punishment. Make sure you know which you're practising. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Aquarius: You care about humanity in aggregate and sometimes miss the individual in front of you. Look closer. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Pisces: The grief hasn't finished moving through you. Let it continue. This situation responds well to direct engagement.

sky_notes: Saturn appears retrograde today. Earth is overtaking Saturn — an apparent backwards loop that happens every year for ~4.5 months. Plan your timecourse accordingly (or don't).
Uranus appears retrograde today. Uranus spends ~5 months of every year appearing to go backwards because Earth laps it. It's tilted 98°, so it's used to looking odd.
Neptune appears retrograde today. Neptune appears retrograde ~5 months a year as Earth laps it. Light from Neptune takes ~4 hours to reach you, so this news is already old.
First quarter: Moon and Sun are ~90° apart, so exactly half the visible disc is lit. Tides are at their weakest (neap) around now.
Mars and Jupiter are within 0.6° of each other in the sky — a line-of-sight coincidence; in reality they are hundreds of millions of km apart.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: geocentric, from JPL Keplerian elements (Standish, valid 1800–2050) + Meeus ch.25/47 for Sun & Moon; checked against PyEphem to within 0.5°
Positions are for ~midday Sydney time on the stated date (tropical zodiac, equinox of date)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
